summary: No reachable security issues. The new ${{ matrix.project }} and ${{ matrix.shard }} expressions in name:, run: and the artifact name come from static literals in the workflow file ([chromium, webkit], [1, 2], [1, 2, 3]). No event data (PR title, branch name, etc.) reaches them, so there is no script injection. The only event-derived values (the changes job's BASE_SHA/HEAD_SHA/DEFAULT_BRANCH) are unchanged and still go through env:. Workflow-level permissions stay contents: read, there are no new actions (pins unchanged), no new dependencies and no secrets. The per-matrix artifact names stop concurrent shards overwriting or colliding with each other. They upload the same playwright-report/ directory as before, only on failure, with 7-day retention, so nothing new is exposed. WeightedSequencer reads only the committed tools/ci/sweep-weights.json through a static JSON import (no runtime path or fs input). assignShards ignores non-finite or negative weights and rejects a bad shard count. Anyone able to edit the weights can already edit the tests, so it is not a trust boundary. The sandbox.ts change copies two fixed repo paths. Randomness: N/A.
